verses: Kaaf Ha Ya Ain Saad
Yeh hai teray perwerdigar ki uss meharbani ka zikar jo uss ney apney banday Zakariya per ki thi
Jabkay uss ney apney rab say chupkay chupkay dua ki thi
Kay aey meray perwerdigar! meri hadiyan kamzor hogaee hain aur sir burhapay ki wajah say bharak utha hai, lekin mein kabhi bhi tujh say dua ker kay mehroom nahi raha
Mujhay apney marney kay baad apney qarabat walon ka darr hai, meri biwi bhi baanjh hai pus to mujhay apney pass say waris ata farma
Jo mera bhi waris ho aur Yaqoob (alaihi as-salam) kay khandan ka bhi janasheen aur meray rab! to ussay maqbool bandah bana ley
Aey Zakariya! hum tujhay aik bachay ki khushkhabri detay hain jiss ka naam yahya hai, hum ney uss say pehlay uss ka hum naam bhi kissi ko nahi kiya
Zakariya (alaihi as-salam) kehney lagay meray rab! meray haan larka kaisay hoga, jabkay meri biwi baanjh aur mein khud burhapay kay intehaee zoaf ko phonch chuka hun
Irshad hua kay wada ussi tarah ho chuka, teray rab ney farma diya hai kay mujh per to yeh bilkul aasan hai aur to khud jabkay kuch na tha mein tujhay peda ker chuka hun

Kehney lagay meray perwerdigar meray liye koi alamat muqarrar farma dey, irshad hua kay teray liye alamat yeh hai kay bawajood bhala changa honey kay to teen raaton tak kissi shakhs say bol na sakay ga
Abb Zakariya (alaihi as-salam) apney hujray say nikal ker apni qom kay pass aaker unhen ishara kertay hain kay tum subha o shaam Allah Taalaa ki tasbeeh biyan kero
Aey yahya! meri kitab ko mazbooti say thaam ley aur hum ney ussay larakpan hi say danaee ata farma di
Aur apney pass say shafqat aur pakeezgi bhi, woh perhezgar shakhs tha
Aur apney maa baap say nek salook kerney wala tha woh sirkash aur gunah gaar na tha
Uss per salam hai jiss din woh peda hua aur jiss din woh maray aur jiss din woh zindah kerkay uthaya jaye
Uss kitab mein Maryam ka bhi waqiah biyan ker. Jabkay woh apney ghar kay logon say alehda ho ker mashriqi janib aayen
Aur unn logon ki taraf say pardah ker liya, phir hum ney uss kay pass apni rooh (Jibraeel alaihi as-salam) ko bheja pus woh uss kay samney poora aadmi bann ker zahir hua
Yeh kehney lagen mein tujh say rehman ki panah maangti hun agar to kuch bhi Allah say darney wala hai
Uss ney jawab diya kay mein to Allah ka bheja hua qasid hun, tujhay aik pakeezah larka denay aaya hun
Kehney lagen bhala meray haan bacha kaisay ho sakta hai? Mujhay to kissi insan ka hath tak nahi laga aur na mein badkaar hun

Uss ney kaha baat to yehi hai. Lekin teray perwerdigar ka irshad hai kay woh mujh per boht hi aasan hai hum to ussay logon kay liye aik nishani bana den gay aur apni khaas rehmat, yeh to aik tey shuda baat hai
Pus woh hamal say ho gaeen aur ussi wajah say woh yaksoo ho ker aik door ki jagah chali gaeen
Phir dard za aik khajoor kay tanay kay neechay ley aaya, boli kaash! mein uss say pehlay hi marr gaee hoti aur logon ki yaad say bhi bhooli bisri ho jati
Itney mein ussay neechay say hi awaz di kay aazardah khatir na ho, teray rab ney teray paon talay aik chashma jari ker diya hai
Aur uss khajoor kay tanay ko apni taraf hila, yeh teray samney tar-o-taza pakki khajooren gira dey ga
Abb chain say kha pi aur aankhen thandi rakh, agar tujhay koi insan nazar parr jaye to keh dena kay mein ney Allah rehman kay naam ka roza maan rakha hai. Mein aaj kissi shakhs say baat na keroon gi
Abb hazrat Isa (alaihi as-salam) ko liye huye woh apni qom kay pass aayen. Sab kehney lagay Maryam tu ney bari buri harkat ki
Aey Haroon ki behan! na to tera baap bura aadmi tha aur na teri maa badkaar thi
Maryam ney apney bachay ki taraf ishara kiya. Sab kehney lagay kay lo bhala hum godd kay bachay say baaten kaisay keren?
Bacha bol utha kay mein Allah Taalaa ka bandah hun. Uss ney mujhay kitab ata farmaee aur mujhay apna payghumbar banaya hai
Aur uss ney mujhay ba-barkat kiya hai jahan bhi mein hun, aur uss ney mujhay namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya hai jab tak bhi mein zindah rahon
Aur uss ney mujhay apni walida ka khidmat guzaar banaya hai aur mujhay sirkash aur badbakht nahi kiya
Aur mujh per meri pedaeesh kay din aur meri maut kay din aur jiss din kay mein doobara zindah khara kiya jaon ga, salam hi salam hai
Yeh hai sahih waqiah Isa bann Maryam (alaihi as-salam) ka, yehi hai woh haq baat jiss mein log shak o shuba)yeh mein mubtila hain
Allah Taalaa kay liye aulad ka hona laeeq nahi, woh to bilkul pak zaat hai, woh to jab kissi kaam kay sir anjam denay ka iradah kerta hai to ussay keh deta hai kay ho jaa, woh ussi waqt ho jata hai
Mera aur tum sab ka perwerdigar sirf Allah Taalaa hi hai. Tum sab ussi ki ibadat kero, yehi seedhi raah hai
Phir yeh firqay aapas mein ikhtilaf kerney lagay, pus kafiron kay liye well hai aik baray (sakht) din ki hazri say
Kiya khoob dekhney sunnay walay hun gay uss din jabkay humaray samney hazir hun gay, lekin aaj to yeh zalim log sareeh gumrahi mein paray huye hain
To unhen uss ranj o afsos kay din ka darr suna dey jabkay kaam anjam ko phoncha diya jaye ga, aur yeh log ghaflat aur bey emani mein hi reh jayen gay
Khud zamin kay aur tamam zamin walon kay waris hum hi hun gay aur sab log humari hi taraf lota ker laye jayen gay
Uss kitab mein Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ka qissa biyan ker, be-shak woh bari sachaee walay payghumbar thay
Jabkay unhon ney apney baap say kaha kay abba jaan! aap unn ki pooja paat kiyon ker rahey hain jo na sunen na dekhen? Na aap ko kuch bhi faeedah phoncha saken
Meray meharban baap! aap dekhiye meray pass woh ilm aaya hai jo aap kay pass aaya hi nahi, to aap meri hi manen mein bilkul seedhi raah ki taraf aap ki rehbari keroon ga
Meray abba jaan aap shetan ki parastish say baaz aajayen shetan to reham o karam walay Allah Taalaa ka bara hi nafarman hai
Abba jaan! mujhay khof laga hua kay kahen aap per koi azab elahi na paray kay aap shetan kay sathi bann jayen

Uss ney jawab diya kay aey Ibrahim! kiya to humaray maboodon say roo-gardani ker raha hai. Sunn agar to baaz na aaya to mein tujhay pathron say maar dalon ga, jaa aik muddat daraz tak mujh say alag reh
Kaha acha tum per salam ho, mein to apney perwerdigar say tumhari bakhsish ki dua kerta rahon ga, woh mujh per hadd darja meharban hai

Mein to tumhen bhi aur jin jin ko tum Allah Taalaa kay siwa pukartay ho unhen bhi sab ko chor raha hun. Sirf apney perwerdigar ko pukarta rahon ga, mujhay yaqeen hai kay mein apney perwerdigar say dua maang ker mehroom na rahon ga
Jab Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) unn sab ko aur Allah kay siwa unn kay sab maboodon ko chor chukay to hum ney unhen Ishaq o Yaqoob (alaihima as-salam) ata farmaye, aur dono ko nabi bana diya
Aur unn sab ko hum ney apni boht si rehmaten ata farmaeen aur hum ney unn kay zikar jameel ko buland darjay ka ker diya
Uss Quran mein Musa (alaihi as-salam) ka zikar bhi ker, jo chuna hua aur rasool aur nabi tha
Hum ney ussay tor ki dayen janib say nida ki aur raaz goee kertay huye ussay qareeb ker liya
Aur apni khaas meharbani say uss kay bhai ko nabi bana ker ata farmaya
Uss kitab mein Ismail (alaihi as-salam) ka waqiah bhi biyan ker, woh bara hi waday ka sacha tha aur tha bhi rasool aur nabi
Woh apney ghar walon ko barabar namaz aur zakat hukum deta tha, aur tha bhi apney perwerdigar ki baargaah mein pasandeedah aur maqbool
Aur uss kitab mein Idrees (alaihi as-salam) ka bhi zikar ker, woh bhi nek kirdaar payghumbar tha
Hum ney ussay buland muqam per utha liya

Yehi woh anbiya hain jin per Allah Taalaa ney fazal o karam kiya jo aulad Adam mein say hain aur unn logon ki nasal say hain jinhen hum ney Nooh (alaihi as-salam) kay sath kashti mein charha liya tha, aur aulad Ibrahim o Yaqoob say aur humari taraf say raah yafta aur humaray pasandeedah logon mein say. Unn kay samney jab Allah rehman ki aayaton ki tilawat ki jati thi yeh sajdah kertay aur rotay girgiratay gir partay thay
Phir unn kay baad aisay khalaf peda huye kay unhon ney namaz zaya kerdi aur nafsani khuwaishon kay peechay parr gaye, so unn ka nuksan unn kay aagay aaye ga
Ba-juz unn kay jo tauba ker len aur eman layen aur nek amal keren. Aisay log jannat mein jayen gay aur unn ki zara si bhi haq talfi na ki jaye gi
Hameshgi wali jannaton mein jin ka ghaeebana wada Allah meharban ney apney bandon say kiya hai. Be-shak uss ka wada poora honey wala hi hai
Woh log o haan koi laghaw baat na sunen gay sirf salam hi salam sunen gay, unn kay liye o haan subha shaam unn ka rizq hoga
Yeh hai woh jannat jiss ka waris hum apney bandon mein say unhen banatay hain jo muttaqi hun
Hum baghair teray rab kay hukum kay utar nahi saktay, humaray aagay peechay aur unn kay darmiyan ki kul cheezen ussi ki milkiyat mein hain, tera perwerdigar bhoolney wala nahi
Aasmano ka, zamin ka aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai sab ka rab o hi hai to ussi ki bandagi ker aur uss ki ibadat per jamm jaa. Kiya teray ilm mein uss ka hum naam hum palla koi aur bhi hai?
Insan kehta hai kay jab mein marr jaon ga to kiya phir zindah ker kay nikala jaon ga?
Kiya yeh insan itna bhi yaad nahi rakhta kay hum ney ussay uss say pehlay peda kiya halankay woh kuch bhi na tha
Teray perwerdigar ki qasam! hum unhen aur shetanon ko jama ker kay zaroor zaroor jahannum kay ird-gird ghutno kay bal giray huye hazir ker den gay
Hum phir her her giroh say unhen alag nikal khara keren gay jo Allah rehman say boht akray akray phirtay thay
Phir hum unhen bhi khoob jantay hain jo jahannum kay dakhlay kay ziyadah sazawaar hain
Tum mein say her aik o haan zaroor warid honey wala hai, yeh teray perwerdigar kay zimmay qataee, faisal shuda amar hai
Phir hum perhezgaron ko to bacha len gay aur na-farmano ko ussi mein ghutno kay bal gira hua chor den gay
Jab unn kay samney humari roshan aayaten tilawat ki jati hain to kafir musalmanon say kehtay hain batao hum tum dono jamaton mein say kiss ka martaba ziyadah hai? Aur kiss ki majlis shandaar hai?
Hum to unn say pehlay boht si jamaton ko ghaarat ker chukay hain jo saaz o saman aur naam naam-o-numood mein unn say barh charh ker thin

Keh dijiye! jo gumrahi mein hota Allah rehman uss ko khoob lambi mohlat deta hai, yahan tak kay woh unn cheezon ko dekh len jin wada kiye jatay hain yani azab ya qayamat ko, uss waqt unn ko sahih tor per maloom ho jaye ga kay kaun buray martabay wala aur kiss ka jutha kamzor hai
Aur hidayat yafta logon ko Allah Taalaa hidayat mein barhata hai, aur baqi rehney wali nekiyan teray rab kay nazdeek sawab kay lehaz say aur anjam kay lehaz say boht hi behtar hain
Kiya tu ney ussay bhi dekha jiss ney humari aayaton say kufur kiya aur kaha kay mujhay to maal o aulad zaroor hi di jaye gi
Kiya woh ghaib per mutlaa hai ya Allah ka koi wada ley chuka hai?
Hergiz nahi, yeh jo bhi keh raha hai hum ussay zaroor likh len gay, aur uss kay liye azab barhaye chalay jayen gay
Yeh jin cheezon ko keh raha hai ussay hum uss kay baad ley len gay. Aur yeh to bilkul akela hi humaray samney hazir hoga
Unhon ney Allah kay siwa doosray mabood bana rakhay hain kay woh unn kay liye baees izzat hun
Lekin aisa hergiz hona nahi. Woh to unn ki pooja say munkir ho jayen gay, aur ultay unn kay dushman bann jayen gay
Kiya tu ney nahi dekha kay hum kafiron kay pass shetanon ko bhejtay hain jo unhen khoob uksatay hain
To unn kay baray mein jaldi na ker, hum to khud hi unn kay liye muddat shumari ker rahey hain
Jiss din hum perhezgaron ko Allah rehman ki taraf bator mehaman jama keren gay
Aur gunah gaaron sakht piyas ki halat mein jahannum ki taraf haank ley jayen gay
Kissi ko shifaat ka ikhtiyar na hoga siwaye unn kay jinhon ney Allah Taalaa ki taraf say koi qol qarar ley liya hai
Unn ka qol to yeh hai kay Allah rehman ney bhi aulad ikhtiyar ki hai
Yaqeenan tum boht buri aur bhari cheez laye ho
Qareeb hai kay uss qol ki wajah say aasman phat jayen aur zamin shaq hojaye aur pahar rezay rezay ho jayen
Kay woh rehman ki aulad sabit kerney bethay
Shaan rehman kay laeeq nahi kay woh aulad rakhay
Aasman o zamin mein jo bhi hain sab kay sab Allah kay ghulam bann ker hi aaney walay hain
Unn sab ko uss ney gher rakha hai aur sab ko poori tarah ginn bhi rakha hai
Yeh saray kay saray qayamat kay din akelay uss kay pass hazir honey walay hain
Be-shak jo eman laye hain aur jinhon ney shaista aemaal kiye hain unn kay liye Allah rehman mohabbat peda kerdey ga
Hum ney uss Quran ko teri zaban mein boht hi aasan ker diya hai kay to uss kay zariye say perhezgaron ko khushkhabri dey aur jhagraloo logon ko dara dey
Hum ney unn say pehlay boht si jamaten tabah ker di hain, kiya unn mein say aik ki bhi aahat to pata hai ya unn ki awaz ki bhanak bhi teray kaan mein parti hai?
